en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a modest two‑storey building with shuttered windows and a central doorway bearing a large sign that reads "HOTEL LAVICA". To the right, down a side lane bordered by a fence and trees, another building displays a sign "Restauracija Lavica", in front of which people and outdoor seating are visible. In the distant background on a hill is a round, temple‑like structure with a domed roof. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century Central European town scene.
